title: cohort-stabilizer-with-slow-start-and-rollback-clauses
author: Maya Singh
description: Motivation: intermittent regressions during canaries were often due to aggressive traffic ramps and cold-path performance variance in small cohorts. This PR introduces a Cohort Stabilizer controller and a 'slow-start' ramp policy for staged rollouts, plus explicit rollback clauses and an automated playbook hook. The change bundle includes: 1) a new controller that enforces a minimum warmup window per cohort and monitors rolling-window latency/quality signals; 2) a slow-start ramp schedule that increments traffic only after passing per-cohort SLO checks; 3) conservative backpressure: when the controller sees latency or error spikes for a cohort it reduces ramp velocity and pauses promotion; 4) rollback clauses that capture snapshot reasons, create an auditable rollback ticket, and optionally trigger immediate swap to the previous stable model variant; 5) telemetry probes and a lightweight audit trail for replay; 6) an operator-facing CLI command and console UI hints to visualize cohort state and manually trigger/override holds. This description contains the checklist and links: - Checklist: [x] controller implementation, [x] unit + integration tests, [x] e2e replay test harness, [x] console hints, [x] documentation pages updated, [x] rollback playbook drafted. - Related Linear tasks: ENG-1892, ENG-1901. - Design doc: https://linear.app/redwood/doc/COHORT-STABILIZER-DESIGN. Notes: the controller aims for conservative behavior by default (slow-start fraction=0.02 initial, step=+2% every condition pass) and exposes tunables for enterprise Dedicated/Private deployments. The rollback clauses are policy-as-data so tenants can opt for automated reversion or manual incident-driven revert. Rolling is safe across region/replica topologies and respects session affinity by default.

release_notes: Introduce Cohort Stabilizer controller to slow-start canaries and reduce false-positive regressions.
New policy fields: slow_start.initial_fraction, slow_start.step_percent, stabilizer.backpressure_thresholds.
Automatic rollback clauses with auditable tickets and optional auto-revert behavior.
Console: cohort timeline visualization and 'cohort inspect' CLI.
notes_for_oncall: If hosts report unexpected holds: check controller metrics (stabilizer.holds_total, stabilizer.backpressure_events) and the e2e replay queue. Use 'redwoodctl cohort inspect <cohort>' to view state and trigger manual override. Rollback tickets are created under the 'rollout-auto' queue with tag 'stabilizer'.
